newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai cabinet backs Ch Karnchan unit subway award.
newsitem.headline: Thai cabinet backs Ch Karnchan unit subway award.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday approved a proposal from state enterprise Metropolitan Rapid Transit Authority (MRTA) to award a 23.9 billion baht ($956 million) subway project to Ch Karnchang Plc's BCKT unit.

MRTA director Thirapong Athacharusit said the 11-km Hualampong-Huay Khwang subway system in central Bangkok would be partly financed by concessional loans from Japan's Overseas Economic Cooperation Fund (OECF).
He said MRTA would sign a project loan contract with OECF on Friday and is expected to award the project to BCKT in about two months.
